verdict.rationale: The Gemini API video docs list video inputs and "multi-turn conversational editing (e.g., element replacement...)", which is a first-party claim of element replacement. It is a single brief mention, and it is unclear whether it describes Veo or the Gemini Omni Flash model named on the same page. The Whisk complaint about redrawing the whole source concerns image-to-video, not element editing, so it is not a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: documentation that the rest of the frame stays intact, restyling (as opposed to replacement) of elements, a clear attribution of the editing feature to Veo itself, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can replace or restyle an element inside an existing video while the rest of the frame stays intact

citations.quote: multi-turn conversational editing (e.g., element replacement or perspective changes)
lets you refine results across multiple turns using the Interactions API
